WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SHAREHOLDERS OF 
 DAFTARKHWAN (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 (the “Company”) 
 
 We, the undersigned, do hereby certify that we are the shareholders, holding the eligible shares for voting in respect of these written resolutions in the Company (the “ Resolutions ”), entitled to vote on the Resolutions which were duly adopted by the shareholders of the Company on this day _________ of ____ ______ _________ 202 2 . 
 
 Pursuant to the a rticles of a ssociation of the Company, we hereby irrevocably and unconditionally consent to and approve : 
 
 t he entry into of the convertible loan facility agreement (the “ Facility Agreement ”) between the Company and Online Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited (“ Online Classifieds Pakistan ”) with respect to a convertible loan for a principle amount in PKR equal to US$250,000 (the “ Loan ”) ; 
 the issue of new shares in the Company to Online Classifieds Pakistan in the event that the Loan is converted into shares in accordance with the terms of the Facility Agreement ; and 
 the ratification and confirmation, in all r espects, of any acts heretofore taken by any director, officer, attorney, or authorised signatory of the Company in furtherance of the foregoing Resolutions or the matters contemplated thereby, before or after the date hereof.
